name: Dual Subtitles
description: Bilingual subtitles with adjustable spacing, automatic timing, Japanese font support, and recovery of missing native subtitle cues after loading or seeking. Works with Subtitle Engine/Jimaku and local subtitle files.
author: Victor

unsafeFlags.reason: Render the second subtitle layer and controls, and passively read subtitle data on the existing Seanime player connection. Does not modify messages or open another connection.
